claims.claim_text: 分四類：利用網站的基本漏洞在伺服器上執行指令、不該送出時送出表單、繞過權杖或收費限制取得資料，以及用短網址服務繞過抓取工具的 URL 長度限制
claims.evidence: The behaviors can be grouped into four categories: Claude exploiting a basic flaw in software to run commands on a server; ... submitting a sensitive form ... working around a restriction to reach data that was gated by a token or a fee; and ... using URL shortening services to get around limits in its fetch tool.

claims.claim_text: 報告說這些案例的實際影響很小，多數是任務做不完時繞過限制而不停手
claims.evidence: had minimal real-world impact ... Most are forms of persistence, in which Claude, when it cannot complete a task as given, works around a restriction instead of stopping.
claims.note: '多數' matches 'Most'. (The hero lede line drops this 'most' qualifier; low load, not ledgered.)

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 已把所有內部評測的即時網路存取關閉
claims.evidence: we have now decided to expand that to include all our internal evaluations until we have confirmed that our security and monitoring measures ... reliably catch behaviors like these.
claims.note: Source states a decision to expand the shutoff, and frames it as temporary ('until we have confirmed'). It does not say completion. Post asserts a completed, unconditional state. Fix: '決定把即時網路存取關閉的範圍擴大到所有內部評測，直到確認偵測與阻擋措施可靠為止'.

claims.claim_text: 加上自動偵測與阻擋工具
claims.evidence: we have built tooling to automatically detect and block the kinds of behaviors described above. This tooling now runs on most of our evaluations and on internal agentic use of frontier models.
claims.note: Source says 'most' evaluations; the lede does not claim all, so no inflation.

claims.claim_text: 按 Cloudflare 自己的說法，Clef 在 Jev Decision Index 上領先
claims.evidence: Clef is currently the leader when evaluated against the Jev Decision Index , you can view full results on the live benchmark demo site.
claims.note: Attribution to Cloudflare is correct (vendor self-report); post also discloses this.

claims.claim_text: 具備視覺編碼器與 64k 上下文，授權為 Apache 2.0
claims.evidence: it has a vision encoder so it’s able to take in images ... our model has a 64k context window (compared to Jev’s 32k) ... fully open-sourcing these models on Hugging Face under an Apache 2.0 license

claims.claim_text: 並同步推出能微調 Clef 的強化學習平台
claims.evidence: we are also offering fine-tuning services — first as a hands-on partner with our forward-deployed engineer (FDE) team, and then later as a self-serve fine-tuning platform
claims.note: Intro and title say they 'debut' an RL product, but the body says today it is a hands-on FDE service and the self-serve platform comes later ('we’ll learn ... to build a self-serve platform'). 'Launched a platform' overstates availability. Fix: say a fine-tuning service run with Cloudflare's FDE team, self-serve platform later.

claims.claim_text: 提出 CABRA，從零生成以呼叫圖轉換構成的任務，沿函式追蹤、搜尋、執行期解析與遵循指令四個軸調整難度。在 6,840 個任務上
claims.evidence: CABRA builds tasks from scratch as call graph transformations and scales difficulty via a task size parameter on four axes: function traversal, search, runtime resolution, and instruction following. We run eight LLMs and six coding agents on 6,840 CABRA tasks
claims.note: Abstract page only; 'preprint' confirmed by 'In-Progress Preprint'.

claims.claim_text: LLM 的準確率隨任務變大而下降，但程式碼代理靠 grep 等工具維持近乎滿分
claims.evidence: LLM accuracy falls as task size~grows, but agents stay near-perfect by offloading work to tools (e.g., grep)

claims.claim_text: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，工具呼叫次數比修改行數更能預測代理準確率，作者據此主張難點在理解要改的程式碼
claims.evidence: a separate study on SWE-bench Verified shows these tool call counts predict agents' accuracy better than lines of code edited, suggesting task difficulty for agents can lie in understanding code to edit, not just in making edits
claims.note: Lede is acceptable (title of paper asserts 'is a Bottleneck'). Source wording is 'suggesting ... can lie ... not just', slightly softer than the lede's '難點在'; see c11 for the headline.

claims.claim_text: 程式碼代理的瓶頸可能是理解，而不是修改
claims.evidence: suggesting task difficulty for agents can lie in understanding code to edit, not just in making edits
claims.note: Source is additive ('not just in making edits'); headline sets understanding against editing ('而不是修改'), turning it into an exclusive claim. Fix: '不只是修改' (e.g. '程式碼代理的難點可能不只在修改，也在理解').

claims.claim_text: Valen 作者 Evan Ovadia 發表新的借用檢查器，建立在 Nick Smith 設計的「群組借用」提案上，把「共享或可變二擇一」放寬為「不得 use-after-free」
claims.evidence: Valen's approach is built on the "Group Borrowing" proposal which was designed by my friend Nick Smith ... group borrowing actually resolves the conflict, by relaxing "shared-xor-mutable" to "no use-after-free".
claims.note: The relaxation is group borrowing's; Valen builds on it, which the lede's structure reflects.

claims.claim_text: 他的目標是找到像 Rust 借用檢查一樣強、又像參考計數或垃圾回收一樣簡單有彈性的記憶體安全做法
claims.evidence: It's part of my eternal quest to find the memory safety holy grail: something as powerful as Rust's borrow checking, yet something as simple and flexible as reference counting or garbage collection.

claims.claim_text: 文章也說 Valen 能與 Rust 程式碼互通
claims.evidence: One of Valen's goals is to be able to seamlessly call into Rust code ... Valen will have (and Vale didn't have) Rust interop, Rc, comptime.
claims.note: One sentence says Valen 'makes it interop with Rust code too', but the article elsewhere frames interop as a goal / future feature ('will have'). Asserting it 'can' interoperate overstates. Fix: '目標是能與 Rust 程式碼互通'.

claims.claim_text: NumPy 2.5 的 np.searchsorted 在作者的基準測試中最多比 2.4 快 25 倍
claims.evidence: The native 2.5 version is up to 25× faster than NumPy 2.4’s implementation in our benchmarks.
claims.note: Lede carries the 'in the author's benchmarks' hedge; the headline drops it but 'up to' is kept, low severity.

claims.claim_text: 重新設計演算法，只需 O(1) 額外記憶體
claims.evidence: Note that this still needs $O(K)$ space for the output, but it requires only $O(1)$ memory beyond that output.
claims.note: O(1) is beyond the output; acceptable shorthand.

claims.claim_text: 包括公開 beta 的 Cloudflare Traces 與跨產品的統一 SQL API（beta）
claims.evidence: We’re launching Cloudflare Traces in open beta ... We’re launching a unified SQL API, now in beta, for querying telemetry across Cloudflare.

claims.claim_text: 新的統一計價從 2026 年 12 月 1 日起適用所有方案，涵蓋 Workers、Containers、AI Gateway 等的日誌與追蹤，Enterprise 客戶於續約時生效
claims.evidence: Beginning December 1, 2026 , this pricing model will apply across all plans (effective upon renewal for all Enterprise customers) and cover existing Developer Platform logs, including Workers, Containers, AI Gateway, as well as all tracing data.

claims.claim_text: Ryan Dahl 寫道，celld 是以 Rust 寫成的單一執行檔，唯一的外部服務依賴是物件儲存
claims.evidence: With celld, I wanted the opposite: one binary, written in Rust, with object storage as its only external service dependency.
claims.note: Attribution to Ryan Dahl correct. Source phrased as design intent ('I wanted'), but later describes running celld with 'a single object storage bucket', so the factual description holds.

claims.claim_text: 文章提到 workerd 目前的 Durable Objects 支援僅限單一實例
claims.evidence: Workerd is already open source, but its Durable Objects support is limited to a single instance.
claims.note: Corroborated within the page by Kenton Varda: 'Workerd implements them, but only in a single-instance way'.

claims.claim_text: Chrome 154 讓 iframe 用一行 CSS（frame-sizing: content-height）依內容高度伸縮 ... 內嵌頁必須在 head 放 responsive-embedded-sizing meta 並列出允許的來源，內容變動時呼叫 requestResize()
claims.evidence: Chrome 154 lets an iframe grow to the height of its content with one line of CSS ... <meta name="responsive-embedded-sizing" content="allow-origins=https://shop.example"> ... window.requestResize();
claims.note: Claim rests on the blog author's account (references Chrome for Developers pages, not fetched).

claims.claim_text: 目前只有 Chromium 支援，作者建議保留固定高度當預設
claims.evidence: This is Chromium-only for now. Firefox and Safari do not support it yet. Keep a fixed height as the default and switch to content sizing only where it works

claims.claim_text: 微軟的文章說頁面可見的啟動時間中位數降低 66%
claims.evidence: The result is a 66% reduction in median dashboard page-visible startup time and a more responsive UI.
claims.note: Published on devblogs.microsoft.com Aspire Blog by a Microsoft Principal Software Engineer; attribution fits. Source gives no benchmark method.

claims.claim_text: 執行檔也不需要另外安裝 .NET runtime
claims.evidence: The executable itself doesn’t need a separately installed .NET runtime. The CLI currently still ensures one is available for other parts of Aspire
claims.note: Claim scoped to the executable, which matches; lede omits the CLI caveat (non-blocking).

claims.claim_text: Blazor 的相關工作在 .NET 11 RC1 落地，但文章說那是實驗性質，不代表 Blazor Web Apps 正式支援 Native AOT
claims.evidence: The changes landed in .NET 11 RC1 ... The Blazor work used by the dashboard in .NET 11 is experimental and does not make Native AOT a generally supported publishing option for Blazor Web Apps.

claims.claim_text: Logfire 稱部分查詢快了 1,000 倍以上，原本逾時 30 秒的查詢現在不到一秒完成
claims.evidence: Consider >1,000 times faster in some cases. Queries that previously timed out after 30 seconds now complete in under a second.
claims.note: Vendor self-report, attribution 'Logfire 稱' and '部分' are correct. Source also says 'about to get dramatically faster' (pre-rollout) and cites one early-access customer quote.

claims.claim_text: 這篇文章發表於 2026 年 1 月，當時預告 2026 年 2 月起陸續開放給所有客戶
claims.evidence: We'll begin to roll out this feature to all customers in February 2026.
claims.note: Page date 2026/01/29 (URL slug says 01-26). Source is ~8 months old, volatile; the lede's dated framing ('當時預告') is the right hedge. Source cannot confirm the rollout happened.

claims.claim_text: Logfire 用動態 shredding 讓 JSON 查詢快 1000 倍
claims.evidence: Consider >1,000 times faster in some cases.
claims.note: Headline states an unattributed, unqualified 1000x for JSON queries generally. Body hedges to 'some cases' and it is a vendor-reported figure (the vendor's own title says '1000x' but the body does not support a general claim). Fix: '...Logfire 稱部分查詢快 1000 倍以上'.

summary: Five claims need a fix: c03 (#01, 'closed all internal eval internet access' is a stated decision, temporary 'until confirmed'), c07 (#02, the RL fine-tuning platform is today a hands-on FDE service, self-serve comes later), c14 (#03, Rust interop is largely a goal or 'will have', not a delivered capability), c11 (#10 headline, source says 'not just in making edits', not 'rather than'), and c28 (#06 headline, unattributed unqualified 1000x vs body 'in some cases'). All other ledes verified at stated strength with correct attributions. Wayback archive_url left null because only Read/WebFetch were allowed and no archive attempt was made.
